newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins ease as downward trend persists.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins ease as downward trend persists.

text.p: Russian MinFins eased on Monday as last week's downward trend continued on covering of long positions and tracking other emerging instruments, dealers said.
"Prices have been going down these days on Greenspan's comments and no bottom (for MinFins) is seen. It is better to keep flat positions now," National Reserve Bank dealer Denis Pakhomov said.
Brady bonds started falling on Wednesday's U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's inflation warning pointing to higher interest rates, with MinFins following the global trend.
"Selling is going on the whole day. No special reason is seen as there is no bad news from Russia," one dealer said.
A London bank dealer said: "You do not need bad news for selling. It is just a technical situation when people are selling because they can buy them back cheaper".
